physical_inputs_still_needed.item: claw state and payload inertial contribution
physical_inputs_still_needed.why: For fixed fingers, combine claw/payload mass properties into the final wrist body. Opening/closing finger dynamics are outside the seven-axis model.

physical_inputs_still_needed.why: MIT packet range validation alone is not a physical torque calibration
